descriptionChirho: To actively hide or conceal something, especially information or truth, from someone (Piel stem: intensive active concealment).
To be hidden or concealed from sight or knowledge, the passive counterpart of the Piel concealment sense (Nifal stem).
To be cut off, destroyed, or perish — used of people or things that are eliminated or come to ruin (Nifal stem with destruction meaning distinct from concealment).
To cause destruction, to annihilate, wipe out, or cut off — the causative counterpart of the Nifal destruction sense (Hifil stem).
To cause something to be hidden or concealed, the causative form of concealment distinct from the Piel intensive (Hifil stem with concealment meaning).
